newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut approves $1.3 bln bond package.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut approves $1.3 bln bond package.

text.p: Connecticut lawmakers on Monday approved plans for the state to borrow $1.3 billion over the next two years for a host of construction projects.

The state Senate and House of Representatives approved three bonding bills to cover a wide range of transportation projects, highway funds and local community projects, a spokesman for Senate Democrats said.
The funds will be distributed on a month-to-month basis by the State Bond Commission, he said.
Lawmakers also on Monday approved a two percent pay raise for state judges, magistrates and certain sheriffs. It will be effective on October 1 of this year.
Monday was the final day of the state legislature's special session, which convened after the regular session ended on June 4.
The next legislative session is scheduled to begin in February 1998.
